24.original: Question the residents of Pla Enni.

25.original: Speak with the overzealous Nu Mou.

26.original: Use the hempen sack to capture a weakened echevore.

27.original: Deliver the echevore to the overzealous Nu Mou.

48.original: Ahhh! A mortal! It's a mortal! Please give me your patronage! Please, please, <hex:021A020203>please<hex:021A020103>!

49.original: You won't regret it, I swear! Just tell me what your troubles are, and I will solve them! Yes, make them disappear!

50.original: What!? You don't have any troubles!? Gah, what am I to do!? I can't afford to let this opportunity slip by!

51.original: Please help me, I beg you! Go and ask the others what I must do to win your patronage!

52.original: I can't afford to let this opportunity slip by! Please, go and ask the others what I must do to win your patronage!

53.original: They wish to know how they might win <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> patronage? If you yourself do not know, there is little and less chance that someone else would.

54.original: Well, never have I heard of such a naive Nu Mou! All know that patronage cannot be forced. Nay, it must come about naturally, arise out of necessity.

55.original: Our friend is being too hasty. It's well and good to desire honor, but one mustn't obsess over it. Tell them they could stand to relax a little.

56.original: They wish to know how they might win <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> patronage? If you yourself do not know, there is little and less chance that someone else would.

57.original: Well, never have I heard of such a naive Nu Mou! All know that patronage cannot be forced. Nay, it must come about naturally, arise out of necessity.

58.original: Our friend is being too hasty. It's well and good to desire honor, but one mustn't obsess over it. Tell them they could stand to relax a little.

59.original: Did you learn how I might win your patronage? Oh, please tell me you did!

60.original: Is...is that what they said? Perhaps they're right. Perhaps I've been too obsessed with honor and I need to relax. And I know the perfect way to do that!

61.original: I need an echevore! Please, go and catch one for me!

62.original: Spirited as the creature is, it's like to put up a fight. You must weaken it first before slipping this sack over it!

63.original: Please, catch an echevore for me! Remember, you must weaken it first and then slip the sack over it!

64.original: Ah, the mortal returns...and with the echevore, I hope!?

65.original: Oooh, such a lusty specimen! I shall enjoy sucking on its tail for that sweet, sweet nectar taste! There's no better way to relax, let me tell you!

66.original: But wait... By bringing this to me, you've done me a service. And by giving you a fitting payment, it becomes─<gasp>─an honorable task! I might not have <hex:021A020203>performed<hex:021A020103> the task, but I was <hex:021A020203>party<hex:021A020103> to it! And near enough is good enough! Ahahaha!
